measurement_noise.method: four repeats of the frozen baseline, 2 simulated hours, multi-core
measurement_noise.implication: Effects below about a tenth of a percent require the pinned mode; larger effects survive.

audit_tool_defects_found_and_fixed: int64 overflow in settlement payout arithmetic, which falsely accused the engine
positions read at or after expiry instead of before it
arbitrage cycles priced against quotes from later in the run inside a concurrent scan
settlement instants wrongly required to net to zero
option positions read from a stream that never carries them, making the exercise audit vacuous
exercise checked only on the summed payout, blind to compensating errors
residuals compared against zero rather than the per-account truncation bound
venue take read from the report it was auditing
chain check written twice wrongly before the report-anchored form worked
mechanisms_that_never_ran: liquidation, margin call, insurance fund, bankruptcy
cross-venue arbitrage, since the population contains no such participant
isolated-margin collateral, which logs one leg of two and is inert under cross margin
borrow repayment: 1229 borrows and zero repayments in 24 hours
